comparators.definition: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse non-alphanumeric spans; GLUE iff normalized labels are equal and nonempty, otherwise OBSTRUCTION.
comparators.known_weakness: Ignores type, coordinates, provenance, missingness and global constraints.

comparators.definition: Token-set Jaccard on normalized labels; GLUE iff score >= 0.5, otherwise OBSTRUCTION.
comparators.known_weakness: Forces a determinate answer and treats a lexical threshold as identity authority.

comparators.definition: UNRESOLVED if label or type is absent; GLUE iff source-native types agree and token Jaccard >= 0.5; otherwise OBSTRUCTION.
comparators.known_weakness: No joint-completion or claim-relative coordinate semantics.

comparators.definition: UNRESOLVED unless every required coordinate is explicitly observed on both sides; OBSTRUCTION on any unequal observed required coordinate; GLUE otherwise.
comparators.known_weakness: Blanket complete-case abstention may destroy identified answers and is not an information-equivalent ideal product.
